Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "crypto"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
default-run = "crypto"
description = "Educational comprehensive cryptography library: ECC, RSA, AES, ChaCha20, SHA, KDF, PQC"

[[example]]
name = "performance_gains_audit"
path = "examples/performance_gains_audit.rs"

# Frozen S3 source snapshots for matched Linux baseline/candidate builds.
[[example]]
name = "s3_pair_baseline_frozen"
path = "experiments/koblitz-s3-pair-query-20261007-v4/baseline.rs"

[[example]]
name = "s3_pair_candidate_frozen"
path = "experiments/koblitz-s3-pair-query-20261007-v4/candidate.rs"

[[example]]
name = "koblitz_n53_compact_replay"
path = "experiments/koblitz-n53-compact-cold-20261009/native_replay.rs"

[[example]]
name = "koblitz_n53_compact_protocol"
path = "experiments/koblitz-n53-compact-cold-20261009/native_run.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "crypto"
path = "src/main.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "n83-exclusion-audit"
path = "research/n83_highk_beyond4405_20261021/native_exclusion_audit.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "ecdlp-audit"
path = "src/bin/ecdlp_audit.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "ic"
path = "src/bin/ic.rs"

# `volcano-rho` — one ECDLP instance carried by explicit Vélu maps to every
# curve of an ℓ-isogeny volcano, with Pollard rho timed on each stratum.
[[bin]]
name = "volcano-rho"
path = "src/bin/volcano_rho.rs"

[[bin]]
# `isoclass-rho` — ECDLP cost across a whole isogeny class (prime, binary and
# Koblitz curves): multi-ℓ walk with verified Vélu/Elkies maps, Pollard rho
# with folds, generator sweeps, shifted instances and controls.
name = "isoclass-rho"
path = "src/bin/isoclass_rho/main.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "volcano-stats"
path = "src/bin/volcano_stats.rs"

# `generator-n0` — E3a of research/generator_effect_ic_20261019: the base's
# cofactor-class count N0 against the volcano study's IC relation yield.
[[bin]]
name = "generator-n0"
path = "src/bin/generator_n0.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "pkm-aux-search"
path = "src/bin/pkm_aux_search.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "quartic-ic"
path = "src/bin/quartic_ic.rs"

# Standalone construction, certificate replay, checked Jacobian arithmetic,
# and catalog export for the explicitly supported hyperelliptic families.
[[bin]]
name = "hyperelliptic-cover"
path = "src/bin/hyperelliptic_cover.rs"

# `icx` — index calculus across every standardized curve (catalog + engine).
[[bin]]
name = "icx"
path = "src/bin/icx.rs"

# `ecdlp-nist` — ECDLP across the fifteen NIST curves (prime, binary,
# Koblitz) with the structural audit, interval solvers, folded rho and the
# Smart attack on constructed anomalous curves.
[[bin]]
name = "ecdlp-nist"
path = "src/bin/ecdlp_nist.rs"

# `ecc2k-guard` — the ECC2K-130 rho campaign's no-fruitless-cycle
# certificate and verifiable seed provenance.
[[bin]]
name = "ecc2k-guard"
path = "src/bin/ecc2k_guard.rs"

# `ecc2k-merge` — the ECC2K-130 distinguished-point merge, byte-for-byte
# with ecc2k130/aws/merge.py.
[[bin]]
name = "ecc2k-merge"
path = "src/bin/ecc2k_merge.rs"

# `ecc2k-status` — the ECC2K-130 campaign dashboard from the slot table,
# ported from ecc2k130/aws/status.py.
[[bin]]
name = "ecc2k-status"
path = "src/bin/ecc2k_status.rs"

# Exact CM polarization checker with a standalone catalog/database CLI.
[[bin]]
name = "jacobian-certificate"
path = "src/bin/jacobian_certificate.rs"

# `jacobian_transfers` — every route from a registered curve into a Jacobian,
# priced against rho under one frozen formula cost model (docs/curves/JACOBIAN_TRANSFERS.md).
[[bin]]
name = "jacobian_transfers"
path = "src/bin/jacobian_transfers.rs"

# `transfer-audit` — enumerate candidate transfers (GHS descent, isogeny moves,
# covers, pairings) of one curve's discrete logarithm, certify subgroup
# preservation, price each in four phases against the matched rho, and emit a
# verdict (research/transfer_audit_20261011).
[[bin]]
name = "transfer-audit"
path = "src/bin/transfer_audit.rs"

# `cryptopro-b-glv-bench` — GLV-2 with the degree-175 isogeny-chain
# endomorphism against width-w NAF on GOST CryptoPro-B, same Jacobian
# arithmetic in both arms (research/cryptopro_b_glv_chain_20261005).
[[bin]]
name = "cryptopro-b-glv-bench"
path = "src/bin/cryptopro_b_glv_bench.rs"

# `cryptopro-b-chain-sweep` — every chain realisation of the CryptoPro-B
# GLV endomorphisms (frozen chain set) with the scalar-multiplication
# parameters around them; counting run with --features cryptopro-b-opcount
# (research/cryptopro_b_chain_sweep_20261006).
[[bin]]
name = "cryptopro-b-chain-sweep"
path = "src/bin/cryptopro_b_chain_sweep.rs"

# `endo-chain-bench` — the curve-generic form of `cryptopro-b-chain-sweep`:
# GLV-2 via a frozen isogeny-chain endomorphism against width-w NAF on any
# short Weierstrass curve (Bandersnatch, Tom-384, CP6-782; CryptoPro-B as the
# positive control); counting run with --features endo-chain-opcount
# (research/endo_native_bench_20261016).
[[bin]]
name = "endo-chain-bench"
path = "src/bin/endo_chain_bench.rs"

[lib]
name = "crypto_lib"
path = "src/lib.rs"

# Checkpointed native ecbench orchestration and recorded-value aggregation.
[[bin]]
name = "volcano-ic-driver"
path = "research/full_volcano_graphwide_ic_20261017/execution/driver.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "volcano-ic-summarize"
path = "research/full_volcano_graphwide_ic_20261017/execution/summarize.rs"

[features]
# Keep the existing Redis TLS behavior in normal builds. The isolated,
# network-disabled N83 capacity worker can omit its unused native OpenSSL
# dependency when cross-building a static Linux binary.
default = ["redis-native-tls"]
redis-native-tls = ["redis/tls-native-tls"]
# Boolean monomial bitmasks of 128 bits instead of 64, so the F2 Gröbner and
# SAT decomposition engines accept up to 128 unknowns
# (`pq_groebner_f2::Mask`).  Off by default: the 64-bit build, its counters
# and its frozen benchmarks are unchanged.
wide-vars = []
# Explicit selected-bin CLI contracts; production builds keep their behavior.
ic-cli-contracts = []
f4-four-tables = []
f4-five-tables = []
f4-wide-tables = []
redis-cache = []
# Verbose tracing in the isogeny rho attack's linear-algebra step.
rho_debug = []
# Field-operation counters in the CryptoPro-B field (`cryptopro_b_field::opcount`),
# for the counting run of `cryptopro-b-chain-sweep`; timing builds leave it off.
cryptopro-b-opcount = []
# Field-operation counters in the curve-generic field (`endo_generic_field::opcount`),
# for the counting run of `endo-chain-bench`; timing builds leave it off.
endo-chain-opcount = []
# Field-operation counters in the one-word field of `semaev_decomp` (`semaev_decomp::opcount`),
# for PS-0 of research/pdp_oracle_speedup_20261011; timing builds leave it off.
pdp-opcount = []

[lints.rust]
# `hashclash_linked` is set by a downstream build script that links the
# HashClash C library (see src/cryptanalysis/md5_hashclash_ffi.rs).
# `ecbench_reader` is set by tools/backend-leaderboard/build.rs, which compiles
# shared ecbench sources without the full harness.
unexpected_cfgs = { level = "warn", check-cfg = ["cfg(hashclash_linked)", "cfg(ecbench_reader)"] }

[lints.clippy]
# The whole allow list; CI runs clippy with -D warnings for everything else.
# Index loops mirror the specs and papers the algorithms come from (state
# matrices, round tables, polynomial coefficients); iterator rewrites of
# them obscure the correspondence without making them safer.
needless_range_loop = "allow"
manual_memcpy = "allow"
# Attack and protocol entry points take their parameters explicitly.
too_many_arguments = "allow"
type_complexity = "allow"
# Constants are grouped as they appear in their standards, not by nibble.
unusual_byte_groupings = "allow"
# Authenticated decryption fails without detail on purpose: no error oracle.
result_unit_err = "allow"
# `chunks_exact(N)` is equivalent to `as_chunks::<N>().0`; rewriting 51 call
# sites would change slice types throughout for no behavior gain.
chunks_exact_to_as_chunks = "allow"

[dependencies]
hashed-ecdl-tensor = { path = "crates/hashed-ecdl-tensor" }
ecdl-tensor-ic = { path = "crates/ecdl-tensor-ic" }
pencil-symbolic-graph = { path = "research/pencil_large_prime_20261029", features = ["reporting"] }
factor-base = { path = "tools/factor-base" }
volcano-cli = { path = "tools/volcano-cli" }
isogeny_algos = { path = "isogeny_algos" }
# Durable per-vertex IC campaign checkpoints; matches volcano-cli's backend.
rusqlite = { version = "0.32", features = ["bundled"] }
# Dataset-only transport accounts each HTTP attempt before transmission.
# Explicit IRSA bootstrap avoids unmetered default credential-chain requests.
aws-sdk-s3 = { version = "=1.155.0", default-features = false, features = ["rt-tokio", "http-1x"] }
aws-sdk-sts = { version = "=1.119.0", default-features = false, features = ["rt-tokio"] }
aws-smithy-runtime-api = { version = "=1.19.2", features = ["client", "http-1x"] }
aws-smithy-types = { version = "=1.9.1", features = ["rt-tokio", "http-body-1-x"] }
aws-credential-types = "=1.3.1"
aws-smithy-http-client = { version = "=1.5.2", default-features = false, features = ["default-client", "rustls-ring"] }
tokio = { version = "=1.54.1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "fs", "io-util", "net", "time"] }
# Portable CPU-time and peak-RSS measurements for ic research reports.
libc = "0.2"
num-bigint = { version = "0.4", features = ["rand"] }
num-traits = "0.2"
num-integer = "0.1"
rand = { version = "0.8", features = ["small_rng"] }
# OS-backed CSPRNG (getrandom(2) on Linux, BCryptGenRandom on Windows, etc.).
getrandom = "0.2"
# Constant-time equality for MAC/tag verification. Public-domain.
subtle = "2.5"
# Zeroize secret material on drop. Best-effort: cannot zeroize internal
# heap allocations of num-bigint, but covers byte buffers and re-assigns
# BigUint fields to zero on drop.
zeroize = { version = "1.7", features = ["zeroize_derive"] }
hex = "0.4"
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = { version = "1.0", features = ["arbitrary_precision", "raw_value"] }
# `raw_value` lets the P-192 CM certificates parse their one float exactly
# (`exact_f64` in p192_cm_relation_search.rs) without `float_roundtrip`, which
# changes every float parse in the crate and broke replay of ecbench evidence
# sealed under the default parser. `arbitrary_precision` is required by the
# exact-float certificate tooling that round-trips large integers.
# Data-parallel sweeps for the isogeny experimental harness.
rayon = "1.10"
# BLAKE3 is kept as a crate: its Merkle-tree construction is too complex to
# reimplement educationally without obscuring the learning goal.
blake3 = "1.5"
sha2 = { version = "0.10", features = ["compress"] }
streebog = "0.10.2"
# DEFLATE compression. Used only by the cryptopals Set-7 CRIME demo
# (challenge 51): the attack treats compressed-output length as a
# side channel, so we need a real LZ77-style compressor for the
# attack to be faithful. Pure-Rust, no_std-compatible.
flate2 = "1.0"
# Base64 codec for cryptopals fixtures (challenge 56 cookie).
base64 = "0.21"
redis = "1.7.0"

path = "benches/pqc_speed.rs"
